items.title: Malls register double-digit growth in June quarter amid drop in travel, rise in temperatures
items.description: As travel remains disrupted and retailers opt for early sales, mall operators point to an upbeat June quarter despite subdued forecasts

items.title: Goldiam International shines brighter on LGD opportunity as global footprint expands
items.description: US market share gains, tariff-proof manufacturing, and Origem’s India expansion strengthen long-term growth prospects

items.title: Goldman tops $1 trillion of M&A, fastest ever to reach the mark
items.description: There’ve been about $1.7 trillion of deals announced so far this year, according to data compiled by Bloomberg which excludes SpaceX’s combination with xAI

items.title: Yum Brands to sell Pizza Hut chain for $2.7 billion to PE firm LongRange Capital
items.description: Under the agreement, private equity firm LongRange Capital will acquire Pizza Hut's operations outside mainland China

items.title: Air India introduces cheaper ‘basic’ fare, meals to cost extra
items.description: The basic fare, available in Economy Class, includes a 15 kg checked baggage allowance, 7 kg cabin baggage allowance and complimentary tea or coffee. Complimentary meals are not included, Air India said in a statement.

items.title: SpaceX options debut draws record volume as investors chase rocket stock
items.description: Options on SpaceX were the second-most heavily traded contracts on individual companies on Tuesday, topped only by Tesla, Trade Alert data showed

items.title: SpaceX overtakes Microsoft, Amazon to become world's fifth-most valuable firm
items.description: The company briefly surpassed Microsoft, valued at roughly $2.92 trillion, before giving up some ground

items.title: Apple plans camera AirPods alongside upgraded foldable iPhone in 2027
items.description: Apple has also explored using the cameras to provide contextual reminders and improve navigation during turn-by-turn walking directions.

items.title: Tata Electronics says TNPCB closes case over Hosur iPhone components plant
items.description: Tata Electronics said the Tamil Nadu Pollution Control Board (TNPCB) has closed proceedings related to a show-cause notice issued to its Apple iPhone components manufacturing plant in Hosur, after finding the company’s response to be satisfactory.

items.title: SEEPCO supplies 6 million barrels of Nigerian crude to Indian refiners
items.description: SEEPCO is an Indian-owned oil producer operating in Nigeria, an OPEC member country.

items.title: SIMCA secures Rs 15.26 crore contract from leading financial services firm
items.description: Starting the 2026-27 fiscal on a strong note, SIMCA secured business worth Rs 15.26 crore, providing significant revenue visibility for the current financial year, a statement said
